notes: nm IDENTITY Alphabet Inc., CIK 1652044, Delaware, one issuer with three share classes: Class A (Nasdaq GOOGL, voting), Class C (Nasdaq GOOG, no vote) and Class B (unlisted, 10 votes); the 10-K cover (filed 2026-02-05, fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, reading/10k_full.txt) lists GOOGL and GOOG on the Nasdaq Global Select Market plus senior notes, and the 10-Q cover of 2026-07-23 adds the Series A/B mandatory convertible preferred depositary shares (GOOGM, GOOGN). Not an ADR and no ratio. The listed security of this run is the Class A share GOOGL: IBKR search_contracts gives contract id 208813719 (NASDAQ, ALPHABET INC-CL A, US); other lines (Mexico 210810660, Switzerland 305691277 and 242506836) and the 2x/income ETFs are not used; GOOG is 208813720. Reporting and quote currency USD, fiscal year ends 12-31 on calendar quarters, filer form 10-K/10-Q, so identity.json stop stays false. All three classes share the same economics per share (ranking equally in dividends and liquidation), and the consolidated per-share data in the filings are not per class. A 20-for-1 stock split took effect on 2022-07-18 (IBKR corporate actions): IBKR prices are split-adjusted, but the prefetch EPS of FY2020 (58.61) and FY2021 (112.20) are PRE-split and must be divided by 20 (2.93 and 5.61); FY2022 onward is post-split.

nm ONE-OFFS (symmetric reading for the analyst): (1) Q2 2026 other income, net was +97,983, of which +99,031 is the gain on equity securities (the 10-Q says the measurement-alternative holdings are primarily one private company; unrealized): after the 21.9B tax effect it added 77.1B to net income and $6.26 to the Q2 EPS of 9.11, and Q1 2026 added 36.9B pre-tax / 28.7B net / $2.35 of the 5.11. So GAAP net income of the first half (174.8B) is mostly a mark, not earnings power; ex these marks Q2 EPS is about 2.85 and Q1 about 2.76. The marks also moved equity (415.3B to 640.5B) and non-marketable securities (68.7B to 131.5B) and raised the deferred tax liability from 0.9B to 22.8B. (2) Operating income carried a $3.5B European Commission fine in Q3 2025 and a $2.1B Waymo employee compensation charge in Q4 2025 (both in the TTM operating income of 147,628: 153.2B if both are added back, 34.4% margin on 445,866 TTM revenue). (3) Q2 2026 operating margin of 34.0% is below Q1's 36.1% while Cloud margin rose to 35.6% (8,814/24,768).

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic (FY2025 28.9%, average 29.3%, incremental ROIC FY2023 to FY2025 21.8%) uses NOPAT 107,382 (operating income 129,039 x (1 - 16.8% effective tax)) over invested capital 431,104 = equity 415,265 + long-term debt 46,547 - cash and equivalents 30,708. It nets only cash and equivalents: marketable securities (96,135) and non-marketable securities (68,687) are left in invested capital, and operating lease liabilities (12,744 non-current plus a current part in accrued expenses) are not added. Netting marketable securities gives invested capital 334,969 and ROIC 32.1%; netting non-marketable securities too gives 266,282 and 40.3%; adding the leases lowers each by about 1.5-2 points. At 2026-06-30 the method breaks: equity+debt-cash is 682,734 because 98B of unrealized pre-tax gains (77B after tax) now sit in equity and in non-marketable securities, and 24B of goodwill and 7.8B of intangibles came with acquisitions (Acquisitions, net of cash, 33.7B in H1 2026). On TTM NOPAT of about 122.8B (147,628 x (1 - 16.8%)) that gives 18.0% on 682,734 but 33.7% on an operating base of 364,710 (equity 640,480 + debt 98,165 - cash and marketable securities 242,474 - non-marketable securities 131,461); the operating base also carries 80.6B of H1 2026 capex that is only partly in service. Read ROIC as about 29-34% on operating capital, not the diluted 18% and not the flattering 40%; the incremental ROIC of 21.8% is on the prefetch basis.

nm CAPITAL STRUCTURE (facts for the later capital bridge, from the 10-Q and the release of 2026-07-22): in June 2026 Alphabet raised 49.6B net through Class A and Class C stock (30.5B) and 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock (19.1B net; 19 million preferred shares, liquidation preference $1,000 each, 18,023 booked in equity, Series A indexed to Class A and Series B to Class C, 385 million depositary shares of $50), and set up an at-the-market program to sell up to $40.0B of Class A and Class C stock, with proceeds 'primarily intended to meet tax obligations' associated with stock awards per the release; senior unsecured notes added 20.3B net in Q2 (24.8B of debt proceeds in the quarter, 3.8B repaid); long-term debt rose from 46.5B (2025-12-31) to 98.2B. The preferred converts mandatorily on or about 2029-05-15 at 2.2520-2.8160 Class A shares (Series A) or 2.2740-2.8420 Class C shares (Series B) per preferred share depending on the 20-day average price (about 43M to 54M shares if all convert; the boundary prices are about 355 and 444 per share, and GOOGL at 317.66 is below the lower one, so the maximum share count applies today); it pays a cash dividend of 12.15 per preferred share a quarter (about 0.60 per depositary share; 86 in Q2). Stock repurchases were 0 in Q1 and Q2 2026 (28.3B in H1 2025) and shares outstanding rose from 12,088 to 12,230 (+1.2%). Funding commitments of 21.9B to private companies/VIEs at 2026-06-30, of which 20.0B contingent on operational milestones of one private company (10-Q Note 5). Free cash flow by quarter: 24.5B (Q3 2025), 24.6B (Q4 2025), 10.1B (Q1 2026), -5.9B (Q2 2026); TTM 53.3B on CFO 185.7B and capex 132.4B. Q2 2026 capex of 44.9B is 37.5% of revenue; H1 2026 capex of 80.6B compares with 91.4B for all of 2025.

nm TRACK RECORD Alphabet gives NO revenue, operating income or EPS guidance in its releases; the only numeric guide in the eight saved releases (2024-10-29 to 2026-07-22) is capital expenditure: FY2025 capex was guided at 91-93B in the release of 2025-10-29 (midpoint 92.0B) and delivered 91.447B (10-K), a ratio of 0.994 (n=1, inside the range, just under the midpoint, so no beat/miss pattern can be read from it). The engine's ratio (EP.track_record) reads only revenue rows, so ticker-check prints no ratio: there is NO revenue track record because Alphabet gives no revenue guidance (a guidance-tier revenue driver or adjust_by_track_record has nothing to stand on; the capex row is kept for information, not for a ratio). The earlier 2025 steps (75B at the Q4 2024 call, 85B at the Q2 2025 call, then 91-93B) and the 2026 steps (175-185B, 180-190B, 195-205B) were given on calls or in the Q4 2025 release, not in the other saved releases, so the track record cannot be built beyond this row from the releases (a gap): capex guidance has been raised at nearly every step, which makes the first guide a floor.
